jobs.title: Add a test for scripts/loop/queue-cli.mjs
jobs.spec:
scripts/loop/queue-cli.mjs has no matching test file (nothing named queue-cli.test.* or queue-cli.spec.*, and no tests/queue-cli.* sibling). Untested code can regress without the gate noticing. Add a focused test for its behavior.

## Requirements (diff-checkable)
- [ ] Create a test file for scripts/loop/queue-cli.mjs (for example tests/queue-cli.test.mjs or queue-cli.test.mjs).
- [ ] The test imports from scripts/loop/queue-cli.mjs and exercises its exported behavior, including at least one edge case.
- [ ] The repo's check command (for example npm run check) runs the new test and passes.

## Evidence
testsForSources in scripts/loop/queue-cli.mjs

## Impact and effort
Impact: medium to high (untested code can regress silently). Effort: medium (write focused tests).
